user_story: As a user, I want to navigate through a multi-level navigation menu to access various sections of the application easily. This will enhance my experience by allowing me to quickly find the features I need. Acceptance criteria: When I click on 'Main Item 1', I should see 'Sub Item' and 'SUB SUB LIST »'. Clicking on 'SUB SUB LIST »' should reveal 'Sub Sub Item 1' and 'Sub Sub Item 2'.
